The membership price is $25 annually, which is approximately $2.08 per month. However, the rider's average ride duration is well under the 45-minute threshold where additional charges apply. Given the low ride duration and the lack of e-bike usage, the pay-per-ride/minute model is more cost-effective. [P1]
